message.content: {"note_claim": "The real Tesla Roadster only performs short hops with cold-gas thrusters (no prolonged hover), rather than the hovering shown in the video.", "label": "PARTIAL", "quote": "Tesla has demonstrated its Roadster electric car using cold-gas thrusters, developed in collaboration with SpaceX, launching—and performing an axial roll in the air—on a short hop.", "reason": "The visible teaser confirms the real demo was a short hop with cold-gas thrusters, but it does not state the 5–6 second duration, McGregor location, or Mach diamonds, and the rest is paywalled."}

parsed.note_claim: The real Tesla Roadster only performs short hops with cold-gas thrusters (no prolonged hover), rather than the hovering shown in the video.
parsed.label: PARTIAL
parsed.quote: Tesla has demonstrated its Roadster electric car using cold-gas thrusters, developed in collaboration with SpaceX, launching—and performing an axial roll in the air—on a short hop.
parsed.reason: The visible teaser confirms the real demo was a short hop with cold-gas thrusters, but it does not state the 5–6 second duration, McGregor location, or Mach diamonds, and the rest is paywalled.
